verdict.rationale: The platform documents submitting asynchronous tasks with create_task and retrieving results later with get_task, plus autonomous long-running agents such as Kosmos, so the 'keeps working unattended' half of the story is supported. Nothing in the evidence shows the product notifying the user when a result is ready; the only completion mechanisms documented are polling or blocking with run_tasks_until_done. missing for 10: completion notifications (email, webhook or push), documented job-duration or long-run guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can start a long research job that keeps working unattended and notifies me when the result is ready

citations.quote: Sometimes you may want to submit many jobs, while querying results at a later time. The platform API supports this
you can submit tasks to the platform by calling the `create_task` method, which receives a `TaskRequest` (or a dictionary with `kwargs`) and returns the task id.
Kosmos autonomously reads literature, writes and executes analysis code, generates hypotheses, and produces a comprehensive cited report.
